portInfo.description: Lučka uprava Rovinj publishes cruise-port parameters: open 24 hours, position 45°05′ N 013°38′ E, maximum depth 5.50 m, maximum vessel length 200 m, with mooring and pilotage among facilities. Jurisdiction text also lists Valdibora basins for cargo and cruise ships and mega-yacht/cruise use. The compact old town is the natural shore day.

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.

thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: If your ship exceeds 200 m or 5.50 m draft envelope, expect tender — verify before planning.
